ActionPlanList takes an optional progress prop (loading | error | ready{isCurrent, actions, closedBy}). Without it the static plan renders as before, so OwnerHome keeps compiling. Phase 5 'Suas 3 ações' (AC-ra-26 home part) can reuse TrackedActionRows from src/features/actions/ActionProgressRow.tsx for editable status and undo.
The 'Ações' tab has no 'N vencidas' badge (prototype). Company exposes no overdue count; add it when the portfolio/home followup provides one.

evidence.summary: tsc --noEmit completed with no errors; the log ends with EXIT_CODE=0.

Unit files read in full or in bounded parts: DateField, UndoNotice, useActionStatus, ActionEditDialog, ActionProgressRow, ActionPlanList, CompanyActionsTab, CompanyTabs, App.tsx routes, and the action-specific parts of ResultPage. Grep found no fetch or /api calls in the unit files. Every action call goes through src/api/actionsApi.ts (IF-005: getCompanyActions, getDiagnosisActions, updateAction).

AC-ra-26: ActionProgressRow shows status, deadline chip (Prazo / Sem prazo / Vencida em, overdue only on the current plan), owner role chip and note. AC-ra-27: useActionStatus saves at once, UndoNotice role=status shows '"{title}" agora está {estado}.' with Desfazer for UNDO_WINDOW_MS = 6000, and undo saves the previous status. AC-ra-28: ActionEditDialog with DateField (DD/MM/AAAA mask, getDateError on blur and submit), owner role select with no person name, note maxLength 500 with counter; PATCH keyed by diagnosisId/actionKey. AC-ra-30: ResultPage passes isCurrent=false to ClosedPlanRows, which renders no controls and shows 'Encerrada em {data} · {estado}'. AC-ra-63: CompanyActionsTab empty state 'Ainda não há ações' with 'Continuar o diagnóstico' (draft) or 'Começar o diagnóstico'.

Stale-state checks: usePlanItems reseeds only when the source array reference changes (parents pass state-held arrays); row saves are ordered by a per-row request id, so only the latest response is written back; closingDate and findClosingDate both map a closed plan to the completedAt of the next newer plan.
